The single image is much larger in pixels; that is not an identity failure. It appears slightly longer in the legs and more detailed in the collar/buttons than guide3. Uniform height normalization cannot itself prove all internal proportions match, so inspect the combined diagnostic lineup before production use.
guide3_compatibility.ratio_meaning: 480px example guide3 body height divided by 1280px SW body height; an illustrative metadata/display comparison only, not approved gameplay scale.
